name: Kyler Phillips
summary: An American bantamweight from MMA Lab (12-5, age 31) on a three-fight losing streak, all decisions: Rob Font, Vinicius Oliveira and Charles Jourdain (April).

how_they_fight.Striking: Long, creative kickboxer with spinning attacks; five knockouts, four in R1.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Two submissions; good wrestling for the division.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped: all five losses are decisions (two split).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Technical; struggles to separate himself on the cards.

patterns: Decisions both ways (five decision wins, five decision losses)

news.text: Added to the UFC 335 main card against Ethyn Ewing.

sources.title: UFC 335 main card confirmed, Charles Oliveira vs Diego Lopes officially headlines
